57982.meaning2: meaning of a word, dictionary meaning

examples.text: me sutan'ti ettha mayā-sadd'attho me-saddo, sotadvāraviññāṇ'attho sutasaddo. tasmā evaṃ me sutan'ti evaṃ mayā sotaviññāṇapubbaṅ'gamāya viññāṇavīthiyā upadhāritan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

aṭṭhārasa kho imā, ānanda, dhātuyo, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu, saddadhātu, sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu, gandhadhātu, ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu, rasadhātu, jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu, phoṭṭhabbadhātu, kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.

57985.commentary: (SNa) rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā'ti rūpam'eva kilesānaṃ paccay'aṭṭhena nimittaṃ, ārammaṇakiriya-saṅkhāta-nivāsanaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena niketan'ti rūpanimittaniketaṃ. visāro ca vinibandho ca visāravinibandhā. ubhayen'api hi kilesānaṃ patthaṭabhāvo ca vinibandhanabhāvo ca vutto, rūpanimittanikete visāravinibandhā'ti rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā, tasmā rūpanimittaniketamhi uppannena kilesavisārena c'eva kilesabandhanena cā'ti attho.

examples.text: rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. saddanimitta … gandhanimitta… rasanimitta… phoṭṭhabbanimitta… dhammanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho, gahapati, niketasārī hoti.

57986.meaning1: comprehensive grammatical treatise written by Aggavaṃsa in the twelfth century

examples.text: tesañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, samaggānaṃ sammodamānānaṃ avivadamānānaṃ sikkhataṃ siyaṃsu [siyuṃ saddanīti oloketabbā] dve bhikkhū abhidhamme nānāvādā.

57987.meaning1: section on grammatical rules in Saddanīti

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ [catassannaṃ saddanītipadamālā passitabbā] ābhānaṃ yadidaṃ paññ'ābhā'ti.

57988.meaning1: disturbed by sound; worried about noise
57988.commentary: (SNa) vātamigo yathā'ti yathā vane vātamigo vāt'eritānaṃ paṇṇ'ādīnaṃ saddena paritassati, evaṃ yo saddaparittāsī hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo ca saddaparittāsī, vane vātamigo yathā, lahucitto'ti taṃ āhu, n'āssa sampajjate vatan'ti.

57989.meaning1: appearance of the sound; manifestation of the noise
57989.meaning2: appearance of sound; manifestation of sound

examples.text: anantarā kho, ānanda, saddapātubhāvā uḷāravaṇṇo me yakkho sammukhe pāturahosi.

57990.meaning2: experiencing sound; conscious of the sound

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā saddappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti saddarāga-ppaṭisaṃvedī ca.

57991.meaning1: enjoyment of sounds; pleasure in noises

57992.grammar: aor of saddaṃ karoti, comp vb, intrans
57992.meaning1: made a sound; made a noise; made a racket

examples.text: addasā kho poṭṭhapādo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna sakaṃ parisaṃ saṇṭhapesi, appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddam'akattha. ayaṃ samaṇo gotamo āgacchati.
mahājano attano attano puttadhītuñātīnaṃ atthāya paridevamāno mahāsaddam'akāsi, mahāpathavī-undriyana-saddo viya ahosi.

tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye bhummā devā saddam'anussāventi, eso itthan'nāmo āyasmā itthan'nāmassa āyasmato saddhivihāriko amukamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī'ti.

57994.commentary: (SNa) saddam'anussāvesī'ti… suvaṇṇakiṅkiṇikaṃ ghaṭṭento viya madhurassarena saddaṃ anussāvesi.

examples.text: dīghassa parajanassa yakkhassa saddaṃ sutvā bhummā devā saddam'anussāvesuṃ, lābhā vata bho vajjīnaṃ
tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ saddaṃ sutvā yāmā devā saddam'anussāvesum

57996.meaning1: taking pleasure in sounds; pleased by noises

examples.text: rūpavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti. sadd'ārāmā, bhikkhave, devamanussā saddaratā saddasammuditā. saddavipariṇāmavirāganirodhā dukkhā, bhikkhave, devamanussā viharanti.

57997.meaning1: taste for sounds; pleasure in noises
57997.commentary: (SNt) arasarūpo'ti ācārarahitasabhāvo. rūpassa assādanavasena uppajjanakasukhadhammā rūparasā. esa nayo saddaras'ādīsu.

57998.meaning2: greed for the sound; desire for the sound

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā saddappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti saddarāga-ppaṭisaṃvedī ca.

57999.meaning2: experiencing greed for the sound; experiencing desire for the sound

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, upavāṇa, bhikkhu sotena saddaṃ sutvā saddappaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti saddarāga-ppaṭisaṃvedī ca.
